response.original_title: Una noche cotidiana en la vida de Yu
response.overview: Wrapped in nostalgia and away from his native Japan, Yu tries to live preserving his customs with his peruvian mother in Perú. The night will be our guide through a regular series of events that take place in the life of young Otaku Crossplay in a daily night in the life of Yu.
response.title: Una noche cotidiana en la vida de Yu
